description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the StartExam.aspx page of an Online Examination System. It handles page load initialization, dynamic course selection based on user semester, navigation, initiation of theory and MCQ exams, and exam validation checks. It interacts with a SQL Server database, manages user sessions, and handles user interface events.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing exam start process, including course selection and exam initiation based on user session data.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; verifies user session, retrieves user semester info from database, and populates course dropdown accordingly.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Initiates the selected exam (Theory or MCQ) by checking availability and setting session variables.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a theory exam; checks if the student has already taken it, and redirects to the exam if not.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of an MCQ exam; performs similar checks and redirection as above.
